ValidationRule.description: If this is the Agency Price Book or Accelerated Price Book, you cannot change the name. This rule is to ensure the flow that references these names isn't broken: Opportunity_Created_AssignPriceBook
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Name), OR( PRIORVALUE(Name) = "Agency Price Book", PRIORVALUE(Name) = "Accelerated Price Book" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change this Price Book's name because it is referenced in a flow.
